sourceContracts.contract: Common Git directory, root HEAD, worktrees directory, immediate worktree directories and their HEAD files only. Ignore refs, objects, index, logs and deeper paths.
One native watcher per commonGitDir, workspace owner references, ignore initial events, 400ms revision debounce, release last reference tears down watcher.

implementation.backendDependencies: QtCore only; QFileSystemWatcher, QThreadPool, SHA-256; existing system Git resolves authorized repository snapshots
implementation.ownership: Host owns stable chat/mount owner IDs. Service owns one watcher instance; canonical common directory groups share watches. Owners are resolved by authorized asynchronous inspect; retarget, release and context revocation remove pending-request mappings before stale completion can subscribe.
implementation.fingerprint: Physical root identity, sorted immediate metadata directory names and bounded HEAD contents/absence. No directory mtimes or ordinary files. Initial scan is a baseline. Only an actual fingerprint change restarts the 400ms debounce; index churn cannot repeatedly postpone an already-detected HEAD change.
implementation.nativePaths: Reconcile registered paths after each scan and reattach atomic-replaced HEAD files. Rescan after successful new attachments closes the scan/attach gap. Last owner removal cancels scans and stops/removes native watches and timers.
implementation.rootAvailability: Windows native directory watches can remain attached to a renamed directory without notifying its old path. A bounded worker probe checks only root availability and physical identity every five seconds while coverage is complete. It does not read HEAD, refs, index, status or parent-directory contents. Disappearance or replacement schedules a full scan; identity change tears down old watches before reattachment. Windows token uses volume/file index plus directory creation time; POSIX uses device/inode and remains untested here. Deferred probes prevent synchronized groups beyond the two-worker cap from being starved.
implementation.fileSafety: Windows canonical paths and same-handle HEAD reads use GetFinalPathNameByHandleW; metadata child junctions and symlinks are rejected. Enumeration is incremental and counts all immediate entries. Actual bytes read, including oversized HEADs, consume the total read budget.
implementation.ui: Matching topology events refresh Source control after in-flight reads settle and refresh loaded worktree settings without replacing dirty drafts. Other repositories do not refresh the active panel. No read-completion event emits topology changes.
implementation.separateStatusPolling: Existing visible-panel five-second status/diff polling is retained. Symbolic HEAD contents do not change on ordinary commits, and this watcher deliberately ignores index/refs/project files.

remainingLimits: This is HEAD/topology notification, not a general Git status watcher or full Stagewise parity claim.

Native OS notifications can be lost or become unavailable. Root identity is checked every five seconds; incomplete coverage retries metadata scans every five seconds. Explicit refresh is available, and existing status/diff polling remains independent.

A directory scan is not an atomic snapshot of all HEAD files. Native events schedule another scan while one is active; successful watch additions also trigger a follow-up scan. This reduces ordinary scan/attachment races without claiming universal loss-free notification.

Bounds constrain path count, bytes and outstanding work. A filesystem or network share can still block an OS read; shutdown waits for the at-most-two workers. Network filesystem cancellation/latency was not runtime-tested.
Windows final-handle containment was tested; POSIX canonical fallback was not runtime-tested and has weaker pathname-race guarantees.
The service does not discover new authority; host must register/release current session/mount owners. Native conversation storage remains single-workspace.
Worktree usage-history accuracy, multi-mount session storage and cleanup remain unimplemented; usageKnown stays conservative.
